title: Cliff Click @ VMSS16: Bits of Advice For the VM Writer
summary: Cliff Click, author of HotSpot's JIT compiler, shares hard-won advice for people writing virtual machines at the VMSS16 workshop. Topics include interpreters, JITs and performance lessons.
why: HN recommends it, and Cliff Click's talks in general, as practical wisdom from someone who built HotSpot and worked on Azul's VMs.

quote.text: I strongly recommend following and listening to videos by Cliff Click who wrote HotSpot and worked on Azul and other VMs.
